lookups.why: To see the signature and understand what the last parameter (the round bound) does — whether it withholds pins above the bound, and whether the new `Some(turn.round_start)` is correct.
To see the definition of HiveStep::Speak and understand the new `turns` and `next_state` fields, and the `round_start` field on each turn.
To find whether any test exercises a round with width > 1 or verifies the pinboard round bound, which the diff comments claim as an invariant.
To understand how the library sets round_start for multi-turn rounds, which determines whether the host's bound is correct.

value.summary: The PR repackages a vendored dependency (flattening the `openhuman_core::openhuman::` path to `openhuman_core::`) and refactors the hivemind episode loop from single-turn steps to multi-turn rounds, committing `next_state` once after every turn in a round is durable and bounding the pinboard read at `round_start`. I need to verify how `read_pinboard` uses the new bound and whether the `HiveStep::Speak` round fields are exercised by any test.
